openwrt_wiki.einleitung: dual band 802.11ac AC1200 gigabit wireless router. There are four non-detachable antennas. The hardware is identical to the Archer A6 v3.
openwrt_wiki.warnung_v4: You might receive the successor Archer C6 v4 which looks identical from the outside but won't ever be supported due to a new kind of CPU being used and the flash being too small. (TP1900BN, wie RE550 und Archer C80)
openwrt_wiki.warnung_dfs: DFS is not supported by the radio driver. Only a few 5GHz channels can be used in most countries.
openwrt_wiki.hardware_highlights: 5Ghz MT7613BEN is handled as a mt7663 case (ChipID=0x7663) which is handled by mt7615 driver. it is handled by the mt76 driver.
openwrt_wiki.oem_installation: Advanced/System Tools/Firmware Update, factory.bin hochladen, Upgrade
openwrt_wiki.tftp: TFTP-Server 192.168.0.5, initramfs-kernel.bin als test.bin, beim U-Boot-Start Taste 4 drücken, tftpboot dann bootm
openwrt_wiki.debricking: Recovery-Seite aktiv, wenn Booten vom SPI-Flash fehlschlägt; aktivierbar durch viermaliges Aus/Ein vor Ende des Bootvorgangs; TFTP nur über serielle U-Boot-Konsole; Recovery-Adresse 192.168.0.1; Rückweg zur Stock-Firmware für C6 v3.2 per LuCI-Image v1.0.9 von dsouza (Forum 87625/288, verifiziert C6 v3.2 EU)
openwrt_wiki.switch_ports: eth0 mit 5 Switch-Ports (WAN, LAN 1-4), gleiche MAC; wan@eth0, lan1@eth0 ... lan4@eth0
openwrt_wiki.dc_buchse: The power connector is a regular 2.1 x 5.5mm barrel plug/socket. Positive polarity on centre pin.
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: To open the device, remove the two screws on the back. Using a plastic spatula gently open the cover starting from LED elevation area.
openwrt_wiki.seriell: Serial connection parameters 115200, 8N1. Do not connect the 3.3V VCC. Use only GND, TX, RX, and the router's power adapter. Foto: Beschriftung "3.3|GND|RX|TX" über Stiftleiste J1
